text: Overall, the filler injection was okay. It wasn't too expensive, and the staff provided good service, but the doctor wasn't very welcoming. I wouldn't go back again.
I went for a skin brightening injection and saw great results. I never paid attention to anything like this before, but the staff and doctor provided excellent advice and service.
I brought my grandmother to Ivy Clinic for a facelift. The staff were incredibly helpful and took great care of her. 💕 …
The lip injection took less than 5 minutes. The doctor just poked and went. The injections weren't even, and there's a lump in my lower lip. They didn't give me any antibiotics.

It was terrible. I got filler injected under my eyes, and now I have swelling, bruising, purple, and green all over. I contacted the admin, and they only responded with a few sentences, asking if I'd been applying compresses.
Anything I asked, they just wanted me to see a doctor. After the injection, I saw the doctor twice, and they both said the same thing, that it would fade gradually. Is it really going to take months to heal? I was so confused. I consulted two other doctors, and they both said that the doctor had hit a blood vessel. Even other people who saw me commented that the doctor must have hit a blood vessel. I was so upset and heartbroken. It's been a month since the injection, and the purple and bruising haven't gone away yet.
They're not taking responsibility and seem to be blaming me, saying it's my own skin. Even when I had my nose done, it wasn't this bad. I'm telling you, it was severe. I have pictures, evidence, and chat logs to prove how awful it was. I'm so depressed. It's the worst filler injection I've ever had.
